question: Which mission by Digantara aims to enhance India's space domain awareness with precise object tracking and imaging in Low Earth Orbit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SCOT Mission.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The SCOT Mission by Digantara has successfully established ground station communication with stable operation in Low Earth Orbit (LEO).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **SCOT focuses on precise object tracking and imaging in Low Earth Orbit (LEO).**
 
• Ground station communication and solar panel deployment have been achieved successfully.
 
• Supports India's space domain awareness, bolstering national security.
 
• IN-SPACe’s Rs 1000 crore Venture Capital Fund drives India's space economy growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Low Earth Orbit (LEO)__

 __
 
• An orbit close to the Earth's surface, ranging between 160 km and 2,000 km above Earth.
 
 
 
• IN-SPACe__
 __
 
• Independent nodal agency to promote private sector participation in India's space industry.
 
 
 
• Venture Capital Fund__
 
 
• Rs 1000 crore fund supports space startups, targeting a $44 billion space economy by 2033.
